subject: general
question: Dantivarman or Dantidurga was the founder of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrakuta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dantivarman or Dantidurga** was the founder of the **Rashtrakuta** dynasty.
 
• The Rashtrakuta dynasty ruled large parts of the Indian subcontinent between the 6th and 10th centuries.
 
• The Rashtrakutas are known for their patronage of art and architecture, especially the rock-cut temples of Ellora.
 
• The dynasty played a crucial role in the history of the Deccan region and contributed significantly to the cultural development of the area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rashtrakutas emerged as a powerful dynasty after the decline of the Chalukyas of Badami.
 
• They were known for their military prowess and extensive trade networks.
 
• Their capital was initially at Manyakheta in present-day Karnataka.
 
• The Rashtrakutas maintained diplomatic relations with the Arab Caliphates and other contemporary powers.
 
• Their rule is considered a golden age for Kannada and Sanskrit literature.
